findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - a client sets groups = 3 and fast_test = "jest --shard={group}/{groups}" with fewer matching test files than groups. review.close_test (src/forge/review.py:386–396) sends fast_test directly here, bypassing fasttest.close_tests, the only path adding --passWithNoTests (src/forge/fasttest.py:287). This substitution therefore produces a valid empty shard whose failure status Forge preserves, making the required tests check fail despite no failing tests. [Jest checks for empty results after sharding and exits 1](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/blob/v30.2.0/packages/jest-core/src/runJest.ts#L194-L245). The compound-script fallback at src/forge/fasttest.py:267–270 likewise bypasses the flag. Handle empty groups on these supported execution paths too; the current direct-command test checks substitution but never exercises an empty shard.
